notes.text:
BF457 astable multivibrator:
- Created astable_multivibrator.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch directly in /home/cua/kicad_project/. Exported astable_multivibrator.net through File > Export > Netlist, KiCad tab. Step 67 confirms clean title and saved schematic status after Ctrl+S.
- BF457 pin mapping verified visually: 1 emitter, 2 collector, 3 base. Default base left; x mirrors horizontally. Both emitters use plain GND.
- Device:R R1/R2=10k base bias; R3/R4=330 LED loads. Device:C_Polarized C1/C2=10uF, one rotation puts positive left; x mirrors positive right. Device:LED one rotation puts cathode down.
- Capacitor positives at respective collectors, negatives at opposite bases. Straight wire crossings made without junction dots; endpoint connections have dots. Supply is +5V; no signal labels or power flags.
- ERC found two undriven power-input errors (+5V/GND), zero warnings. Final visible topology matches eight planned nets, but no independent parsed netlist comparison was made.
- Export recipe: File (10,58), hover Export (83,192), Netlist (198,219), Export (650,774), verify filename/directory, Save (757,913), Ctrl+S. Export sets unsaved marker until saved again.
- Initial F1 zoom moved sheet offscreen; Home then toolbar zoom (221,86) restored usable view. Otherwise placement/duplicate/wire batches worked without feedback errors.
- Previous buck scored 0.67, bipolar ADC 0.33, while simple value edits and empty netlist scored 1.00. These support persistence/export workflows, not full correctness of arbitrary populated builds. This astable has no evaluator score yet; +5V supply choice remains a design assumption.
